observations: body L1-L13: the quotation of aṣ-Ṣūfī continues from p. 295. The long dashes of the Arabic names measure 5.0 to 5.6 pt, and the hyphens of «c’est-à-» (L10) 3.1 and 3.0 pt. The second a of the first «al–han‘ah» (L3) prints open, like u, and the o of «Scorpion» (L13) prints broken, like c. The Arabic word of L6 is «ذيل» (dhayl, the hem of the robe).

body L20-L36: the long dashes of the Arabic names measure 4.4 to 5.5 pt; the second «an-na‘ā’im» (L23) has a hyphen (3.0 pt). «designé» (L23) and «enchainée» (L33) are printed so. A point between the two w of «al–awwal» (L27) and a point under the dash of «al–farghāni» (L29) are specks. The Arabic words are «قامة» (L31), for the leg, and «متن» (matn, the back, L34).

body L37-L43: «aṣ–Ṣūfī» and «al–Battānī» are letter-spaced, with long dashes (5.3 and 5.5 pt). «supérieurité» (L42) is printed so. A point between «et» and «se» (L38) is a speck. The Arabic word of L38 is «مذهبه» (madhhabuhu, his doctrine).
notes_left L1: «d» is an italic Latin letter among the Greek letters.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
